search.website_text: # Glance Dalamud plugin for [RPHub.co](https://rphub.co) - view and share FFXIV roleplay profiles in-game. Think TRP3, but for XIV. [Discord](https://discord.gg/rbSWGK9gvT) | [Plugin Page](https://rphub.co/glance) ## Install 1. Dalamud Settings > Experimental > Custom Plugin Repositories 2. Add `https://rphub.co/dalamud/pluginmaster.json` 3. Search "Glance" in the installer You'll need [Dalamud](https://goatcorp.github.io/dalamud-docs/) and a free [RPHub.co](https://rphub.co) account. ## What it does - Profile tooltips when you target players, with at-a-glance info for walk-up RP - Custom nameplate icons, names, and titles for Glance users - Nearby player discovery with distance - Chat name replacement with profile names - Private local notes per character - Real-time sync between web and plugin - Console/non-plugin users can link profiles too ## Terms By using Glance you agree to the [Terms of Service](https://rphub.co/terms-of-service). - **Use at your own risk** - third-party tools may violate the FFXIV User Agreement - **Beta** - provided as-is, may contain bugs - **NSFW** - zero tolerance, instant ban - **AI imagery** - zero tolerance, all uploads must be human-made or in-game screenshots - **Age** - must be 16+ RPHub is a personal fan project. No fees, no ads, no revenue. All FFXIV content is property of Square Enix. Glance and RPHub are not affiliated with Square Enix. ## License Glance (the client-side Dalamud plugin) is licensed under the [GNU Affero General Public License v3.0](LICENSE.txt). If you distribute modified versions or host them as a network service, you must make your source available under the same terms. The RPHub.co backend service that Glance communicates with is a separate, closed-source program operated by RPHub.co and is not covered by this license. --- Built by [@purpleheartdev](https://bsky.app/profile/purpleheartdev.bsky.social) for the XIV RP community
